title: Giving in the Church
definition: Giving in the Church is the generous, cheerful, and faithful sharing of resources for worship, ministry, mercy, and mission.
summary: Christian giving flows from grace and supports the work of Christ's people.
christFocus: Jesus Christ gave Himself for us, and His grace teaches His people to give freely and joyfully.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Giving in the Church teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is christian giving flows from grace and supports the work of christ's people.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. Giving in the Church calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let giving in the church move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
